Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor procurement kickoff — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO steps

Hi Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Per our discussion, attaching the current DPA draft for Redwood review and the exported subprocessor list. Our SOC 2 Type II report is public at the link below — the control summary and last audit letter are there.

Attachments:
- vendor-DPA-20261019.pdf (pdf)
- subprocessor_list_20261019.csv (csv)

SOC 2 report: https://vendorco.com/soc2/report-2026-07.html
Evidence bundle (read-only): https://docs.vendorco.com/soc2/evidence-2026

As next steps we want to confirm:
1) Redwood PO process and the contact for invoice routing (so we can populate vendor profile).
2) Whether the DPA needs to go into DocuSign or you prefer a redlined PDF exchange.
3) Any procurement-specific fields required on our invoice (PO number format, remit address).

Happy to hop on a short call with procurement if that helps — we can schedule for tomorrow afternoon PST.

Best,
Alice Murphy
Head of Procurement Operations
VendorCo Inc.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor procurement kickoff — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO steps

Alice — thanks, received. I reviewed the attachments quickly and forwarded to procurement to confirm PO specifics (cc: Ben). A few notes / asks before we proceed: 

- Can you confirm who will sign the DPA on your side (name + title)? We typically e-sign via DocuSign but can accept a redline exchange if legal prefers.
- We require a CSV or table that maps subprocessors to data categories they process (the attached CSV looks like the list only). If you can add a short column describing data processed (PII, telemetry, logs) that will speed review.
- For PO routing: Ben, can you confirm Redwood's vendor setup checklist and the expected SLA for issuing a PO once a W‑9 / vendor profile is completed?

If helpful, Alice, we can provide a one-page procurement checklist and a PO template (Ben — see below). Otherwise, upload the W‑9 and the updated subprocessor CSV to the evidence link and flag the DocuSign envelope if you create one.

Subject: Re: Vendor procurement kickoff — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO steps

Thanks — looping procurement in. Alice, welcome. Quick answers to the asks: 

- PO issuance: once vendor profile is complete (W‑9 + remit address + invoice contact) we usually issue a PO within 3 business days if no legal holds. For newly onboarded vendors it can take up to 7 business days.
- Invoice fields: please include our legal name exactly as "Redwood Inference, Inc.", the PO number (we will provide), net 30 terms unless otherwise negotiated, and remit to the address on the portal.
- Portal: please upload your W‑9 and invoice contact to our vendor portal link: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/PO-portal (Procurement will validate and mark vendor ready).

I've attached our blank PO template to make it easy to format invoices. Also: if you prefer an email-based DocuSign for the DPA, send the envelope to legal@redwood.com and copy me.

Attachments:
- PO-template-redwood.xlsx (xlsx)
